effort: Read all thirteen design files in full (~17,650 lines): timeline.md and README first as the anchor, then ch01–ch10 for scene-level dates, then combat/character/portraits/team/structure/world/act-1/falsified/method-delta, then threads.md (the per-chapter state file, which 'wins' by its own rule) both in full for C1–C5 and by targeted search for C6–C9 to settle specific objects (the grease tin, the register corner, the turnips, the mittens, Kajiya reading the bed on the 15th, entry 42 at 8/5). ~178 rows produced, one per (atom, holder); know/her-son-fixed-the-tone was split into two rows for its two holders. Three method decisions worth flagging: (1) the notation has no room below Y0, so I extended it on the ledger's own arithmetic — Y-1 = age 9, Y-2 = age 8, Y-3 = age 7, Y-50 for Kongō's fifty years — and marked every such row CAL. (2) Where the vocabulary writes a duration (Y0M6–M7, Y0M4 to Y0M8), I dated the START and noted the end in the event column; BET is reserved for genuine uncertainty about when, not for spans. (3) For years 1–3 the design is explicit that no month calendar exists (timeline.md §7.4), so those rows are YnM? — RULED where the design states the age or year outright (portraits.md's year tables, 'acquired at eleven'), CAL where I derived the year from act structure (act two = age 11 = Y1), AFT where the design says only 'act two onward, undated'. Four corrections to the supplied vocabulary fell out of the dating: know/medic-three-days is Y0M2 not Y0M1 (ch1 sc9 follows the month-2 event); know/the-hundred is Y0M3 not Y0M4 (she left m3 26 and 'about the fourth day out' is m3 29 by ch04's own pinned clock); know/mother-was-never-coming is Y0M4 not Y0M5 ('ask me tomorrow' is said on m4 6); and every ch1-sourced atom is Y0M1–Y0M2, because no scene in that chapter carries a date. Five internal conflicts found and flagged rather than resolved: Mikage's death year (timeline.md says Y1, falsified.md/threads.md/structure.md say year 2), Kimimaro's control bone ('four months' vs 'thirty-eight days'), the Hanase hunter contact (7/3 vs 7/14 vs 7/20 vs 7/23 — all inside Y0M7), day-level drift inside month 6 (coat and parcel entries), and know/shimoda-lived ('two years' vs 'at eleven').
